content.short: Beethoven X is a Balancer-based DEX on the Optimism blockchain.
content.description: Beethoven X is a decentralized exchange protocol that aims to reengineer and reimagine the decentralized finance landscape. Founded by an anonymous team, users can invest in listed tokens and trade them. Its interface includes an internal pool aggregator to view, select, and contribute to liquidity pools. It also provides APIs for developers to query subgraphs and verify pools.
